table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	SELECTED='N',
	Type=S.Type,
	CRS_ClientName= CL.Name + 
		CASE WHEN CI.Description IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' - ' + CI.Description + ' - ' END + 
		'(' + CI.Name + ')',
	Date=S.Date,
	InvCode=S.InvCode,
	ClientInstanceID=S.ClientInstanceID,
	Customer = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = S.CustCode), 
	CustRefNo=S.CustRefNo,
	CustRefNo2=S.CustRefNo2,
	CustRefNo3=S.CustRefNo3,
	CustRefNo4=S.CustRefNo4,
	CustRefNo5=S.CustRefNo5,
	Remarks=S.Remarks,
	InvTotal=S.InvTotal
FROM 
	CRS_ClientInstance CI, 
	CRS_ClientList CL,
	(SELECT 
		Type= 'S',
		S.ClientInstanceID,
		S.Date,
		InvCode=S.SaleInvCode,
		S.CustCode,
		S.CustRefNo,
		S.CustRefNo2,
		S.CustRefNo3,
		S.CustRefNo4,
		S.CustRefNo5,
		S.Remarks,
		S.InvTotal
	FROM CRS_SaleLedger S
	WHERE 
		LEN(ISNULL(:as_searchtext, '')) > 0 AND 
		S.ClientInstanceID = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid IS NULL THEN S.ClientInstanceID ELSE :ai_clientinstanceid END AND
		S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		(:as_type = 'S' OR :as_type ='' OR :as_type IS NULL) AND
		S.CustCode = CASE WHEN :ai_custcode IS NULL THEN S.CustCode ELSE :ai_custcode END AND 
			(S.CustRefNo LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%') OR 
			S.CustRefNo2 LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%') OR 
			S.CustRefNo3 LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%') OR 
			S.CustRefNo4 LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%') OR 
			S.CustRefNo5 LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%') OR 
			S.Remarks LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%')) 
	UNION
	SELECT 
		Type= 'S',
		S.ClientInstanceID,
		S.Date,
		InvCode=S.SaleInvCode,
		S.CustCode,
		S.CustRefNo,
		S.CustRefNo2,
		S.CustRefNo3,
		S.CustRefNo4,
		S.CustRefNo5,
		S.Remarks,
		S.InvTotal
	FROM CRS_SaleLedger S
	WHERE 
		LEN(ISNULL(:as_searchtext, '')) = 0 AND 
		S.ClientInstanceID = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid IS NULL THEN S.ClientInstanceID ELSE :ai_clientinstanceid END AND
		S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		(:as_type = 'S' OR :as_type ='' OR :as_type IS NULL) AND
		S.CustCode = CASE WHEN :ai_custcode IS NULL THEN S.CustCode ELSE :ai_custcode END
	UNION
	SELECT 
		Type= 'R',
		S.ClientInstanceID,
		S.Date,
		InvCode=S.SRInvCode,
		S.CustCode,
		S.CustRefNo,
		S.CustRefNo2,
		S.CustRefNo3,
		S.CustRefNo4,
		CustRefNo5='',
		S.Remarks,
		S.InvTotal
	FROM CRS_SRLedger S
	WHERE 
		LEN(ISNULL(:as_searchtext, '')) > 0 AND 
		S.ClientInstanceID = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid IS NULL THEN S.ClientInstanceID ELSE :ai_clientinstanceid END AND
		S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate  AND
		(:as_type = 'R' OR :as_type ='' OR :as_type IS NULL) AND
		S.CustCode = CASE WHEN :ai_custcode IS NULL THEN S.CustCode ELSE :ai_custcode END AND 
		(S.CustRefNo IS NULL OR S.CustRefNo2 IS NULL OR S.CustRefNo3 IS NULL OR S.CustRefNo4 IS NULL OR S.Remarks IS NULL) AND
			(S.CustRefNo LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%') OR 
			S.CustRefNo2 LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%') OR 
			S.CustRefNo3 LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%') OR 
			S.CustRefNo4 LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%') OR 
			S.Remarks LIKE ('%' + ISNULL(:as_searchtext,'') + '%'))
	UNION
	SELECT 
		Type= 'R',
		S.ClientInstanceID,
		S.Date,
		InvCode=S.SRInvCode,
		S.CustCode,
		S.CustRefNo,
		S.CustRefNo2,
		S.CustRefNo3,
		S.CustRefNo4,
		CustRefNo5='',
		S.Remarks,
		S.InvTotal
	FROM CRS_SRLedger S
	WHERE 
		LEN(ISNULL(:as_searchtext, '')) = 0 AND 
		S.ClientInstanceID = CASE WHEN :ai_clientinstanceid IS NULL THEN S.ClientInstanceID ELSE :ai_clientinstanceid END AND
		S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate  AND
		(:as_type = 'R' OR :as_type ='' OR :as_type IS NULL) AND
		S.CustCode = CASE WHEN :ai_custcode IS NULL THEN S.CustCode ELSE :ai_custcode END AND 
		(S.CustRefNo IS NULL OR S.CustRefNo2 IS NULL OR S.CustRefNo3 IS NULL OR S.CustRefNo4 IS NULL OR S.Remarks IS NULL) ) AS S
WHERE 
	CL.ClientID = CI.ClientID AND
	CI.ClientInstanceID = S.ClientInstanceID
ORDER BY
		Date
